name: research-paper-workflow
description: A traceable, evidence-first dual-AI workflow for research positioning, quantitative analysis, scientific figure optimization, evidence-preserving manuscript reconstruction, manuscript drafting, independent review, submission packaging, and science communication.

interface.shortDescription: Build and audit evidence-traceable research papers.
interface.longDescription: A modular workflow that keeps questions, data, results, figure plans, claims, manuscript text, independent review, submission records, and communication outputs linked. Includes scientific figure optimization, evidence-preserving manuscript reconstruction, dual-AI quality gates, and a P2 Tibetan Plateau-Arctic sea-ice adapter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the research-paper-workflow to validate publishability, audit evidence before drafting, optimize figures as argument units, reconstruct manuscripts without changing facts, preserve uncertainty, and keep every claim traceable to local results.
